_note: M-MODES WeaponCatalog (docs/spec/modes.md §3). stats: dmg/rof/rng are 0-100 UI bars; mag/reserve/reload_ms are literal. 'base' names the WEAPON_TAILS template in gameconfig.py the $WEAP tail is built from; only assault_rifle(ar)/charge_rifle(charge) are hardware-fired -> verified:true, the rest are templated -> verified:false (pin by a one-field Callsign capture, protocol-classes Method). 'melee' is hidden (slot 4, never in the picker).

weapons.name: Assault Rifle
weapons.desc: The house standard, and one of only two frames fired straight off stock hardware. 24 a hit every 850ms, 32 up and 384 in reserve — no gap and no edge; every other weapon is measured against it.

weapons.name: Burst Rifle
weapons.desc: An assault rifle wound tighter. Rapid 14-damage taps from a 36-round mag, 216 in reserve - ride the trigger in short bursts at range, not as a hose.

weapons.name: Sniper Rifle
weapons.desc: One bolt, one long lane. 60 a hit on a 1.5s cycle, four in the mag and 1.7s to reload — a miss puts you on the clock while they close.

weapons.name: Shotgun
weapons.desc: Doorways and corners. 50 a hit at 1.1s with six shells and a 400ms reload — the fastest recovery in the arsenal, paid for in range.

weapons.name: SMG
weapons.desc: A hose. 12 a hit every 400ms with 72 in the mag: it wins by volume inside close range and does nothing at distance, and the 2.5s reload is the longest wait for the smallest number.

weapons.name: AMR
weapons.desc: Anti-materiel weight at a rifle's cadence. 40 a hit every 900ms with 14 up and a 1.4s reload — heavy per trigger pull, on a mag shallow enough to count.

weapons.name: Energy Launcher
weapons.desc: Charge, commit, erase. A 1.5s spool into a single 95-damage shot on a 2s cycle, one in the tube and six in reserve — every shot is a decision.

weapons.name: Rail Gun
weapons.desc: A slug that does not care what it hits. 1.8s charge, 90 on impact, one shot and a 2.4s reload — the longest downtime on the roster for the flattest shot on it.

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.desc: Area denial, twice. 115 a hit — more than a default kit's HP and armor combined — on a 1.8s cycle, with two in the tube, a 1.2s reload and only eight rounds behind it: spend them on clusters.

weapons.name: Laser Cannon
weapons.desc: The biggest single number in the arsenal. 150 a hit on a 1.6s cycle with four shots and eight held back — a two-magazine weapon you carry for one fight.

weapons.name: Charge Rifle
weapons.desc: The other frame verified off a real gun, and the only confirmed charge behaviour we have. A 1.25s spool into a 150-damage shot with 100 in the mag and a 2.5s reload — hold the lane, do not hold the trigger.

weapons.name: Bolt Rifle
weapons.desc: Deliberate. 30 a hit every 700ms from an 18-round mag with 180 behind it — a marksman's rifle for operators who count shots, and a 2s reload that keeps them honest.

weapons.name: Plasma Sniper
weapons.desc: A sniper you can actually work with. 55 a hit on a 1.3s cycle, 10 in the mag and 80 in reserve — less punch than the bolt gun and far more forgiving of a miss.

weapons.name: Force Rifle
weapons.desc: Assault-rifle numbers in a bigger box. 24 a hit at 850ms with 36 up and 144 back — the same trade as the standard rifle, deeper mag, shallower reserve.

weapons.name: Stinger
weapons.desc: Fast, light, relentless. 30 a hit every 600ms with 18 in the mag and 72 in reserve — it out-paces rifles at mid range and runs itself dry doing it.

weapons.name: Energy Rifle
weapons.desc: A 300-cell battery that never really stops. 10 a hit every 200ms — the smallest per-hit number and the highest sustained pressure on the roster; the 2.4s reload is rare and expensive when it comes.

weapons.name: Suppressor
weapons.desc: Quiet trigger, steady rhythm. 20 a hit every 500ms with 48 up and 288 in reserve — a support gun for pinning a lane, not for winning a duel.

weapons.name: Ion Sniper
weapons.desc: Two shots, both of them serious. 80 a hit on a 2s cycle with a 2s reload — the hardest single hit outside the launchers, with no margin at all for a miss.

weapons.name: Melee
weapons.desc: Last resort: no ammo, no reload, no noise until it lands. 90 on contact at arm's length — hidden from the picker and always bound to slot 4.
